nodes.name: cut-island
nodes.notes: Runs on host python3 (no image key, M1). Reads the C6 boundary and the Reconstruction read-only, trims to the polygon and writes the C1 island dir + C2 cut-report.json the gate re-hashes.

nodes.name: render
nodes.notes: Pinned Blender 5.2.2 image, gpu: true (C3/C4). The Runner mounts only the workdir and passes no working directory, so the Node script travels baked in the image at this exact relative path (WORKDIR /work). Both stills come from one scene.

nodes.name: grade
nodes.notes: Names only the render Node's raw outputs plus the C5 sky input, never the Reconstruction or island dir (D4): Grading cannot alter a Reconstruction by construction.

nodes.name: check-showcase
nodes.notes: Gate (C7): measures C4 on the render Node's raw RGBA stills (the alpha mask) and re-hashes the Reconstruction against the C2 report; the graded stills are only the optional sanity pair. Exits non-zero on failure, which stops the run; verdict.json is a declared output, so a gate that writes nothing fails too.
